source.author: stat
source.text: obvius huic, latus omne virum stipante corona, fit iuvenis, ferrumque ingens sub pectore duro condidit, atque imas animae mucrone corusco scrutatus latebras tandem sua monstra profundo reddit habere Iovi.
source.text_original: obvius huic, latus omne virum stipante corona, / fit iuvenis, ferrumque ingens sub pectore duro / condidit, atque imas animae mucrone corusco / scrutatus latebras tandem sua monstra profundo / reddit habere Iovi.
source.text_english: Meeting him, with a broad band of men crowding around him on every side, a young man advances and buries a huge sword beneath the hard chest; and, having searched out with the flashing point the deepest hiding places of his life, at last he gives his monster back to deep Jove as his own.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: Tartareo turn sacra Iovi Stygiisque ferebat manibus Alcimede tanto super auxia nato, siquid ab excitis melius praenosceret umbris.
reuse.text_original: Tartareo turn sacra Iovi Stygiisque ferebat / manibus Alcimede tanto super auxia nato, / siquid ab excitis melius praenosceret umbris.
reuse.text_english: Then Alcimede was bringing sacred rites to Tartarean Jove and to the Stygian spirits, as an added support for her mighty son, if from the summoned shades she might learn anything better in advance.
